summary: After crowded meetings and a rally, a council sends its budget back and the rate rise shrinks to a quarter of the first plan.
realLife: A town manager first proposed raising the property tax rate by sixteen cents. After residents packed meetings and rallied outside town hall, the council told staff to revise and the rise became four cents. The budget fell by about six million dollars, with road resurfacing cut by a quarter, a park project dropped, a two million dollar emergency contingency removed, and two vacant jobs unfunded. The council set another hearing.
sources: StarNews via Yahoo (Leland, North Carolina), 'Amid cries for no tax increase, Leland asks for less from residents in new budget', Apr 19, 2024: https://www.yahoo.com/news/amid-cries-no-tax-increase-150436491.html
